Remark 8. When the elements xi of a vector x reach
consensus, i.e., x1 = · · · = xn, both ∥Qx∥and diam(x) are
zero. Otherwise, they have positive values, which become
larger as xi’s diverge away from consensus. In other words,
∥Qx∥and diam(x) quantify the discoordination among xi’s.
Moreover, Lemma 2 implies that ∥Qx∥and diam(x) are
equivalent measures of the discoordination among xi’s.
